subject: sty
title: (R)STY.------PROJ.DY.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-35. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'The retrograde affinity tendency functions as a factor to keep the people of its culture aware of the dynamic route of its path.' The crossing diagrams how reality-of-style structurally meets projectional-dynamics at the retrograde-affinity-tendency scale: (R)STY crossed with PROJ-DY. STY sits at left with the subject-arrow; PROJ-DY at center as partner-axis. AF-POST (affinity postulation) branches up to the left from the main line and carries RIT-DT (ritual dictates), which carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) branches up to the right and carries POL-SIGN (political significance) and CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis), which carries OBS (observation) and SPT-DE, which carries MD-DY (media dynamics). PRI-INFO (principle information) branches down to the right and carries LK-IMP (linkage implications), which carries PER-DY (perception dynamics).
